note: Measured facts about one music take. Times are seconds in the audio file. Fill it in with sound/analysis/*.py (see sound/README.md) and listen; never guess the grid. Keys marked optional may be left out.

sections.name: groove
sections.note: the repeating part: whole loops of loopBars bars

spliceWindow.note: downbeats where a loop splice may land: one bar into the groove to one bar before it ends

shortOutro.note: optional: a jump inside the outro (a -> b) that still sounds like an ending, used only when the full outro cannot land the final chord on the end card
